description: Disconnect a connected store: deletes the stored connection and its credential, stops future syncs, and removes the products imported from it. Irreversible; reconnecting the store re-imports its catalog. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_disconnect_ecommerce_store
title: Disconnect Ecommerce Store
